rationale: No repo code change: the wrapper drives auto-round 0.17.0 through its public API (AutoRound scheme W4A16 = int4 g128 full-range sym, iters 200, nsamples 128, seqlen 2048, batch 8, seed 42, device_map 0, low_gpu_mem_usage False, bf16 model as the repo loads it). D1: quantize_and_save(format=auto_round) packs GPTQ-style (qweight int32, fp16 scales, quant_method auto-round, packing_format auto_round:auto_gptq); the wrapper asserts bits/group_size/sym in config.json. D2: the <model>-w4g128 subfolder that quantize_and_save creates is moved up so OUTPUT_DIR holds config.json, quantization_config.json and the safetensors. D3: in-wrapper reload pins AutoRoundConfig(backend=auto_round:tritonv2_zp) and logs the QuantLinear class that ran. D7: sym=True kept (Marlin uint4b8). D8: NeelNanda/pile-10k (repo default, seed 42) when a timed Hub probe succeeds, else the first nsamples Pile-validation texts with >= seqlen tokens read line by line from the local val.jsonl; the choice is logged. D9: low_gpu_mem_usage False (fits 24 GB). The patch only adds quantport_autoround/README.md because a bundle needs a non-empty patch.
